Title: Azure Monitor for Containers - Updates on Windows AKS Support, UI enhancement, and Node Storage Capacity

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for Containers Updates on Windows AKS Support, UI enhancement, and Storage Capacity

  • Pin to dashboard for the 4 charts in cluster view
  • UI Enhancement on the Observability Live data console (vertical resizing available)
  • Linux Node Storage capacity monitor and alerting
  • Monitor AKS support on Windows (public preview)

For more detailed information, please go to documentation.
